description: Orchestrates AI-assisted novel writing and GitHub-based serialization. Use when the user asks to write a novel, create characters, build worlds, draft chapters, check continuity, or publish chapters to a GitHub repository. Covers the full lifecycle: world-building → character design → chapter drafting → continuity verification → GitHub publishing.
